sequence: Find the complete original CPM lesson pages including Review & Preview homework and image assets.
Extract every source-numbered problem verbatim, including subparts, mathematical symbols, tables, and diagrams.
Preserve the source original as variation 1, with source number, lesson, and source file/hash.
For numerical variations, replace only source numerical inputs with linked mathematically valid values. Do not rewrite question wording or figure structure.
Recalculate every corresponding answer independently, testing degeneracies and whether diagrams need regeneration.
Do not change a fixed diagram number unless a matching regenerated graphical stimulus exists; keep source-only otherwise.
Check source provenance, visual rendering, MathJax, graph/image fidelity, variation duplication, and teacher-review status.
Recheck unchanged Direct Skills, MC, Extensions, Chapter 1 and Chapter 3, and verify installer source hashes against the current mirror.
Package one GitHub Transfer ZIP, no Git writes. Further passes target only remaining R&P defects and source-dependent swaps.
For existing CPM spiral families with mathematically swappable values, add the new versions to the same family and expose New Question only when multiple verified candidates exist.
For Diamond Problems use canonical Tools/graph_tool.py make_diamond; regenerate all four diamond diagrams with changed values, preserve omissions, and recompute product/sum.
Check every new question mathematically, validate MathJax, check tool-output images and preview each representative format at narrow lesson-column width.
same_question_policy: Preserve exact source words for originals and variants; change only explicit numeric givens; never paraphrase original CPM.
difficulty_policy: Review & Preview has NO difficulty levels or 1/2/3 selector; display original CPM item first, followed by mathematically verified same-task number swaps, all in one pool.
source_copy_policy: Remove only browser/site controls, retain original student-facing text, subparts, and original diagrams; TeX from source is restored from saved math scripts.
approval_policy: Teacher-review draft only, not assessment-eligible until accepted.
numeric_variation_policy: Generate where all mathematical givens and answers can be synchronized; otherwise source-only with no fabricated solution.
image_display_policy: Every source diagram must resolve in both file:// and local server modes. Prefer self-contained exact original PNG bytes in display questions; audit every rendered img rather than counting bundled assets.
visual_quality_gate: Render all Review & Preview originals; verify each image loads (naturalWidth>0), correct aspect, and no alt-text-only fallback. Check original-only 1/1 handling and same-task refresh. Do not show difficulty levels.

tile_pattern_diagram_policy.originals: Preserve verbatim original CPM student text. When the source has an occupied-cell tile diagram, redraw exactly those occupied squares as deterministic vector unit tiles; keep original transcription in provenance.
tile_pattern_diagram_policy.text_only_patterns: For text-only number-based tile patterns, add a labeled teacher-created possible arrangement while retaining exact CPM wording. Draw only mathematically determined figures; avoid giving a worked rule in the student diagram.
tile_pattern_diagram_policy.number_swaps: When varying tile counts or rates, regenerate all diagram squares from the same parameter values and independently verify image counts at every figure and the resulting rule.
tile_pattern_diagram_policy.student_constructed: Do not show a completed answer pattern when CPM asks the student to invent or draw one.
tile_pattern_diagram_policy.verification: Count SVG tiles in every rendered variation; confirm slopes, intercepts, source original figure counts, and table/diagram fidelity. No Review & Preview difficulty selector.

stage9_result: Original source exact diagrams for 2-22, 2-59, 2-67 and source-consistent diagrams for 2-6. Added 22 computed same-task number-swapped variants to 2-22 and 2-59.
stage10_scope: Only Review & Preview question variants; do not change Direct Skills, Summative MC, Extensions or chapter 1/3.
